description:
Create a stream (optionally with its first schema version and sources)
A stream (shown as 'Bag' in the dashboard) fans one canonical schema in from many forms.

changelog.description: A short human note on what changed in this version, shown in the version history.

json_schema.description: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 describing the submission data. `required` drives drift detection and mapping completeness.

ui.description: Per-field rendering hints keyed by field name (label, placeholder, widget, options, order) — used to render embed snippets.

form_id.description: The form feeding this stream (mutually exclusive with `selector` in principle, though only one source kind is currently supported).

const.description: Use this fixed value instead of anything from the source.

default.description: Fallback value when the resolved value is missing.

expr.description: A JSONata expression evaluated against the source's data.

from.description: Copy this field's value from the source form's submitted data.

mapping.description: Keyed by the stream schema's field names. Each entry is exactly one of `from` (copy a field from the form's data), `const` (a fixed value) or `expr` (a JSONata expression), plus an optional `default`. Every required field in the stream's schema must be covered or this call fails 422 mapping_incomplete.

selector.description: Reserved for non-form sources (not yet implemented).

name: streams_create
